speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; to begin my assessment of this newborn with respiratory distress, can you tell me their gestational age and how many hours old they are? Also, were they born prematurely or via a difficult delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on the history of premature birth, cesarean delivery, and maternal gestational diabetes, this raises concern for transient tachypnea of the newborn or neonatal sepsis.
